mathematical_contract.injective_axis: On a regular parallel fragment the offset derivative is one continuous scalar multiple of the source derivative. The fragment invariant excludes source singularities and interior offset cusps, so the scalar cannot change sign in the open interval. Any strictly monotone source coordinate is therefore strictly monotone on the retained exact parallel fragment, possibly with reversed orientation.
mathematical_contract.disjoint_pair: Two fragments with the same certified strictly monotone coordinate have disjoint complete images when their exact endpoint-coordinate intervals are strictly disjoint. If the intervals meet at one coordinate value, strict monotonicity makes that value unique on each fragment and decided-distinct endpoint points exclude even a tangency.
mathematical_contract.adjacent_pair: Two adjacent loop carriers whose common exact endpoint is already seeded as a topology vertex can meet only there when one shared certified coordinate sends their remaining endpoints into opposite open half-lines.
mathematical_contract.simple_loop_side: A one-loop material region may reuse its exact cached filled side only after every retained carrier is injective and every broad-phase candidate pair is proved disjoint or adjacent-endpoint-only. AABB-pruned pairs already carry exact disjointness evidence. Any overlap, self-contact, second operand, unknown role/side, non-analytic pair, or undecided comparison uses the general side-ray classifier.
mathematical_contract.fallback: Every failed or undecidable structural proof falls through to the existing complete exact resultant and side-classification authorities. No heuristic negative is introduced.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 traverse the same exact topology. Approximate policy can decide only an otherwise unresolved scalar equality/sign through Hyperlimit's 512-bit terminal, and the enclosing CurveOutcome records Approximate512Consumed.
